ItemId.description: The layout's 26-character id; omit it to match by name or create one.

Form.description: Where the check sits on the sheet.

X.description: Distance from the left edge of the check, in points.

Y.description: Distance from the top edge of the check, in points.

Width.description: Width the field may take, in points; 0 for no limit.

Hidden.description: Whether the field is left off.

Fields.description: The place of each field by name: Date, Payee, PayeeAddress, Amount, AmountInWords, Memo, Number, Payer, Bank, Signature, SecondSignature.

OffsetX.description: Calibration: how far everything moves right, in points.

OffsetY.description: Calibration: how far everything moves down, in points.

PrintMicr.description: Whether the check line prints; it needs a check line font uploaded on the site.

MicrCountry.description: The country whose check line format is used.

UseAuxiliaryOnUs.description: Whether the check number prints left of the routing number (business checks).

MicrFontSize.description: The check line font size, in points.

MicrSymbolCharacters.description: The four characters the font draws the transit, amount, on-us and dash symbols on.

PayerName.description: The payer's name printed on blank stock.

PayerAddress.description: The payer's address printed on blank stock.

SecondSignatureAbove.description: The amount above which a second signature line prints.

Layouts.description: The check layouts to create, or update by id or name. Signatures and fonts are uploaded on each site.
